params.name: after
params.description: To fetch next page of results, use `?after=<end_cursor>`

params.name: before
params.description: To fetch previous page of results, use `?before=<start_cursor>`

params.name: created_after
params.description: Filter subscribers who have been created after this date (format yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: created_before
params.description: Filter subscribers who have been created before this date (format yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include on each subscriber. Valid options: `attribution`, `tags`, `location`, `canceled_at`. `canceled_at` may only be used together with `status=cancelled`.

params.name: include_total_count
params.description: Set to `true` to include the `total_count` in the response. This option can cause slow responses; if paging through results, request it only on the first page and reuse the value for subsequent pages.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Default 500, maximum 1000.

params.name: slim
params.description: When `true`, omits expensive optional fields from the response. Produces a faster, smaller response — useful when extra fields are not needed.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter subscribers who have this status (`active`, `inactive`, `bounced`, `complained`, `cancelled` or `all`). Defaults to `active`.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Filter subscribers who have been updated after this date (format yyyy-mm-dd)

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Filter subscribers who have been updated before this date (format yyyy-mm-dd)

items.docs:
Behaves as an upsert. If a subscriber with the provided email address does not exist, it creates one with the specified first name and state. If a subscriber with the provided email address already exists, it updates the first name.

If you include a custom field key that does not exist on your account, the request returns an error. Use [List custom fields](/api-reference/custom-fields/list-custom-fields) to retrieve existing keys, or [Create a custom field](/api-reference/custom-fields/

If you include a custom field key that does not exist on your account, the request returns an error. Use [List custom fields](/api-reference/custom-fields/list-custom-fields) to retrieve existing keys, or [Create a custom field](/api-reference/custom-fields/create-a-custom-field) to add new fields before setting them for subscribers.

NOTE: We support creating/updating a maximum of 140 custom fields at a time.

params.name: email_sent_after
params.description: Filter to stats for emails sent after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)/nNOTE: This will only include stats for emails sent in the last 5 years.

params.name: email_sent_before
params.description: Filter to stats for emails sent before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)/nNote: Only data for events in the last 5 years will be included.

items.docs:
Retrieve email stats for a specific subscriber. You can filter the stats by providing `email_sent_after` and/or `email_sent_before` query parameters to limit the stats to emails sent within a specific date range.
Note: Only data for events in the last 5 years will be included.
